programme.title: Mr. Church
programme.desc: When a young girl and her dying mother are joined by a black male cook who comes to live with them, little do they know that their lives are about to change forever.

programme.title: Christmas in Compton
programme.desc: Big Earl (Keith David) runs a Christmas tree lot in Compton, and he demands success from all of his employees. His son causes a lot of trouble when he crosses the line to prove he can be successful.

programme.title: Mad Money
programme.desc: After her husband loses his job, upper-crust housewife Bridget Cardigan (Diane Keaton) is forced to take a job as a janitor at the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City, Mo. Spotting a weakness in the bank's security system, Bridget convinces her two new friends Nina (Queen Latifah) and Jackie (Katie Holmes) to help her steal a fortune in worn-out bills that have been earmarked for destruction.

programme.title: Medusa Deluxe
programme.desc: Talented and cutthroat hairstylists at a competition find one of their own murdered before judging can begin. Winding through neon-lit halls, competitors unspool long-simmering resentments and lies as they search for the killer among them.

programme.title: Never Back Down
programme.desc: Jake (Sean Faris) moves to Orlando, Fla., with his mother (Leslie Hope) and brother (Wyatt Smith). He feels like an outsider in his new school and frequently lets his temper flare out of control. But Jake wants to fit in, and he decides to go to a party with his classmate Baja (Amber Heard). There, Jake is pushed into a fight and humiliated. Another classmate (Evan Peters) sees what happened, and encourages Jake to visit martial arts trainer Jean Roqua (Djimon Hounsou).

programme.title: Fast and Fierce: Death Race
programme.desc: Jack is on his way to grabbing the cash prize for an illegal car race in Mexico to California, when a desperate woman, fleeing from her gangster boyfriend who runs the tournament, jumps into his car pleading for help.

programme.title: Miss Dial
programme.desc: A consumer affairs rep in a rocky relationship spends her day calling random people, looking for new connections. She unexpectedly meets someone on the phone that might just change everything, including her heart.

programme.title: Eve of Destruction
programme.desc: An anti-terrorist (Gregory Hines) hunts a walking bomb made by a scientist (Renée Soutendijk) in her own image, with all of her hang-ups.

programme.title: The Last Letter
programme.desc: Catherine Wright struggles with a debilitating sleep disorder. Her husband Michael struggles to cope when their newborn son lies awake.

programme.title: Original Gangstas
programme.desc: Successful Los Angeles football coach John Bookman returns home to Gary, IN, when his father is murdered. Discovering the town overrun with violent street gangs, John is even more horrified to learn his father was shot by a member of the Rebels, a gang John himself helped form in his youth. John teams up with Jake and Laurie, the parents of a boy who was also killed by a Rebel, to organize their neighborhood against gang violence.

programme.title: School Dance
programme.desc: A teen (Bobb'e J. Thompson) hopes to impress a girl he likes by winning a spot on his school's hottest dance crew.

programme.title: A Family Matters Christmas
programme.desc: Christmas is anything but ordinary when bickering siblings in a newly blended household magically switch bodies.

programme.title: Crash
programme.desc: Writer-director Paul Haggis interweaves several connected stories about race, class, family and gender in Los Angeles in the aftermath of 9/11. Characters include a district attorney (Brendan Fraser) and his casually prejudiced wife (Sandra Bullock), dating police detectives Graham (Don Cheadle) and Ria (Jennifer Esposito), a victimized Middle Eastern store owner and a wealthy African-American couple (Terrence Dashon Howard, Thandie Newton) humiliated by a racist traffic cop (Matt Dillon).

programme.title: Reasonable Doubt
programme.desc: A prosecutor (Dominic Cooper) commits a fatal hit-and-run, then manipulates the case so that the man who was arrested for the crime is acquitted. After the trial, he discovers that his actions have freed a guilty man.

programme.title: 12 Rounds 3: Lockdown
programme.desc: Framed for a homicide by his fellow officers, a detective (Dean Ambrose) tries to expose the conspiracy to clear his good name.

programme.title: As Good as Dead
programme.desc: Bryant befriends a troubled teen and introduces him to martial arts. As Bryant's mysterious and dangerous past catches up to him, he is forced into a life and death struggle to clear his name, save the boy and get back all he left behind.

When a student writes the police code for homicide, 187, inside a textbook owned by teacher Trevor Garfield (Samuel L. Jackson), he feels threatened. The principal dismisses the incident, but, soon after, Trevor is stabbed by the same student. Fifteen months later, a physically and emotionally scarred Trevor relocates to California and takes up substitute teaching. To his dismay, his new school is as full of dangerously undisciplined students as the last one, driving Trevor over the edge.

programme.title: The Last Black Man in San Francisco
programme.desc: Jimmie and his best friend Mont try to reclaim the house built by Jimmie's grandfather, launching them on a poignant odyssey that connects them to their past, even as it tests their friendship and sense of belonging in the place they call home.

programme.title: Chaos
programme.desc: A veteran detective is teamed with a rookie cop when they are sent to negotiate with a bunch of criminals holding a bank hostage. It transpires that a master thief has planted a computer virus that will drain funds from the bank's accounts. The detective faces a race against time to catch the thief and stop the randomly evolving computer virus, which models its behavior on the bewildering principles of chaos theory.

programme.title: The Women of Brewster Place
programme.desc: A multigenerational story of the lives of several black women who call an inner-city tenement home.

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night: Give Me Your Life
programme.desc: As Gillespie (Carroll O'Connor) and Harriet prepare to leave for their honeymoon, Forbes (Carl Weathers) clashes with a charismatic cult leader (Peter Fonda) who has arrived in Sparta.

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night: A Matter of Justice
programme.desc: The trail of a serial killer leads the sheriff (Carroll O'Connor) and police chief (Carl Weathers) to a prominent citizen in Sparta, Miss.

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night: Who Was Geli Bendl?
programme.desc: Only the sheriff (Carroll O'Connor) knows the identity of an actress (Sydne Rome) returned home to Sparta, Miss.

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night: By Duty Bound
programme.desc: A murder suspect (Corbin Bernsen) works for a businessman running against Gillespie (Carroll O'Connor) for sheriff.

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night: Grow Old Along With Me
programme.desc: Gillespie (Carroll O'Connor) and Forbes (Carl Weathers) link a suspect to a witness of a hit-and-run fatality.

When a student writes the police code for homicide, 187, inside a textbook owned by teacher Trevor Garfield (Samuel L. Jackson), he feels threatened. The principal dismisses the incident, but, soon after, Trevor is stabbed by the same student. Fifteen months later, a physically and emotionally scarred Trevor relocates to California and takes up substitute teaching. To his dismay, his new school is as full of dangerously undisciplined students as the last one, driving Trevor over the edge.

programme.title: Beyond the Spotlight
programme.desc: Shaquille O'Neal, who went from being poor and bullied to NBA stardom, reveals how his stepfather taught him the valuable lesson that "true pressure is not knowing where your next meal is coming from."

programme.title: The Originals With Suzy Kolber
programme.desc: Steve Young redefined the quarterback position, setting records as both passer and rusher during his Hall of Fame career; behind the scenes, he battled crippling anxiety that was tougher than any opponent; when football was over, he built a $10 billion business from scratch; Suzy Kolber reconnects with her former broadcast partner to find out what it takes to be a dual threat — on the field and in life.

programme.desc: A ninja prisoner at a hard labor camp is released when he agrees to accept a mission to take down a criminal organization.

programme.desc: Lee stars as Constable Lu, an honest cop embarking on a mission to deliver eight valuable jade miniature horses to a wealthy lord. Blackie co-stars as Lu's partner, together the duo embark on a journey filled with danger and fights at every turn.

programme.title: Wu Tang Clan: The Heroes
programme.desc: THE HEROES, offers an intriguing variation on the Shaolin theme, starting with the familiar account of the burning of Shaolin Temple, and the repression of Shaolin Kung Fu by the Manchurian-backed Qing rulers. Here the focus is on a former Shaolin man, Marshal Kao, who takes his former classmates prisoner, and instead of executing them, proposes to his Qing commander that he torture them and break their spirits until they're willing to fight on behalf of the Qing's.

programme.title: Crane Fighter
programme.desc: A beautiful young girl (Judy Lee) secretly learns the deadly art of the Crane technique against the wishes of her father, himself a former Shaolin man.Soon Judy becomes an expert and has a run-in with local Manchu lackeys who are on the warpath for all Shaolin students. Enter the debonair Raymond Lui, who teams up with Judy, and together they defeat the evil Manchu warlord Kao Chin Chun.

programme.title: Invincible Armour
programme.desc: John Liu and Hwang Jang Lee star together in this awesome kung fu film. The storyline involves a man who is framed for murder and must fight to clear his name while authorities pursue him. Great fighting styles and high kick action!

programme.title: Mean Streets of Kung Fu
programme.desc: When challenged by a local gangster, a top martial arts student (Barry Chan) proves his skill and determination and defeats the thug. Now it's open warfare and fierce battles between the forces of good and evil.

programme.title: 13 Styles Strike aka Eighth Wonder of Kung Fu
programme.desc: Various martial art masters converge in Taiwan to partake in a massive tournament of the martial arts. However, it's not just other martial artists that the combatants must face, but also the Triads and their thugs.

programme.title: Iron Monkey
programme.desc: Iron Monkey is the nickname of a young man who becomes the sole survivor of a Manchurian massacre. After burying his family, a fate-filled road leads Iron Monkey to the Shaolin Temple, where he masters with agility the fearsome Monkey Fist method.

programme.title: Lone Wolf and Cub
programme.desc: A tale of wandering and vengeance by Hai Itto, a master of the Suio style of swordsmanship and a former official intermediary with a sword blade, and his son Daigoro, who lost his wife's life and his job at the hands of the Yagyu clan led by Retsudo.

programme.title: One Armed Swordsman - Tange Sazen: The Legendary Blades
programme.desc: The world was in the time of the 8th Tokugawa Shogun, Yoshimune. ------The feudal lord of the Matsukura clan in Oshu was an enthusiastic collector of famous swords.He was eager to acquire two of the most famous swords in the world, Magoroku of Seki, and two swords, Kengun and Kunryu, large and small.Eizaburo Suwa, one of his retainers and the best swordsman in the clan, was ordered to acquire these two swords even if it cost his life.

programme.title: Chivalrous Inn
programme.desc: Patriotic sword fighters are for and against the Ching (Manchu) Dynasty as they head towards the Martial Inn. Three old men with long silver hair (who are very difficult to tell apart!) are key characters, along with a number of young men and very pretty young women, all very capable sword fighters. Buried under the smoldering looks, suspicions and even lines spoken in dialogue poetic couplets, there's even a murder mystery.

programme.title: Method Man aka Fearless Young Boxer
programme.desc: After his father is murdered by a cold blooded killer, Xiao Lung joins an acrobat troupe in order to further his skills in martial arts. One day while performing he sees the killer, who is after other members of the troupe, like Xiao Lung's father they are-break away members of a large and powerful gang. Xiao Lung is no match for the killer, but after all the other members of the troupe are wiped out, it's up to Xiao Lung to get revenge on them all.

programme.title: Wandering Monk
programme.desc: After a number of deathly mishaps, Monk Lu bravely rescues the bewildered young orphan Cheng, and teaches him the essence of martial arts. The two roam the countryside seeking the murderers of Cheng's father...

programme.title: 52 Masters
programme.desc: Will trains in the ancient samurai art of the sword: Kenjutsu.
programme.sub-title: 52 Masters: KENJUTSU-SWORD of the SAMURAI with Bruce Nguyen

programme.title: A Life of Ninja
programme.desc: A Kendo teacher (Chen Kuan-Tai) protects a businessman from ninja assassins.

programme.title: Ninja Kill
programme.desc: Purple ninjas are on the rampage and plan to assassinate an important senator and create a puppet state headed by the vixen Miss Littleton. For Gordon, the only way to stop them is to learn their ninja laws and then take on each fighter one by one. And then he still has to contend with Littleton and her acrobatic ninja ladies before the country is secure.

programme.title: Thunder Blade & Lightning Foot
programme.desc: Flash Legs Tan stars as a member of the Foot Clan, whose leader is killed by a mysterious masked swordsman using the Thunder-Blade. Tan sets out on his quest to find the murderer and he enlists the help of the Eagle Claw Clan. Together they un-mask the culprit and bring peace to the martial world once again.

programme.title: Lone Wolf and Cub
programme.desc: Hai Itto is always a target. Just as he was receiving a request for assassins from Saeki in the precincts of the Ararenji Temple, the Ura Yagyuans, led by Ishine, attacked him with arrows. Itto, who had been cutting down these Yagyuans sent by Yagyu, who were hiding in the form of Unsui, was hit in the chest by an arrow with a poisoned tip, which Ishine had fired. Daigoro tried his best to save Itto, who was still in a coma.

programme.title: Lethal Three - Sanbiki ga Kiru
programme.desc: Okei meets Tako in a village haunted be a demon and Tono-sama and Sengoku are recruited to become security enforcers.
programme.sub-title: Lethal Three - Sanbiki ga Kiru: Episode 15

programme.title: Duel at Forest aka Duel at the Forest
programme.desc: Pai Lung (Man Kong-Lung) returns home from a prison sentence for accidentally killing the father of his girlfriend Snow (Sally Chen). Upon arriving, he finds that Snow has gotten married to the town's gambling addict an all-around loser Chu Hu. The casino in town is being run by a Westerner (Robameice Deimikor) and his band of thugs that keep things running smoothly.

programme.title: Diamond Ninja Force
programme.desc: Born a Ninja, die a Ninja! A century old feud between the Black Ninja Clan and the Diamond Ninja Empire is on the brink of erupting once again with the discovery of the ancient tomb of the Ninja warriors. Black Ninja descendant, Cogan is determined to defeat the Diamond Ninjas once and for all, but with Gordon of the Diamond Ninjas doing everything to stop him, he is willing to go to hell and back to enlist the Ghost Ninjas to do his evil bidding.

programme.title: Shaolin Iron Claws
programme.desc: Warlords rebel against the government. One chief leaks a secret document to the police. The two brothers discover the power of the document and numerous assassins and warlords are deployed to try to force them to give up the secret.

programme.title: Lethal Three - Sanbiki ga Kiru
programme.desc: While relaxing on their journey, the travelers get caught up in a battle of heirs after a local lord dies.
programme.sub-title: Lethal Three - Sanbiki ga Kiru: Episode 4

programme.title: Hell's Wind Staff
programme.desc: Kung fu super villain, Hwang Jang-Lee (known among fans as "Silver Fox,") is the main attraction in this brilliant kung fu flick, which was reportedly adapted from a comic book. Impudent but likeable kung fu students Tiger Wong (Meng Yuen Man) and Stone Dragon (Meng Hoi) have the potential to be great fighters but seem more interested in driving their teachers to distraction.

programme.title: Point the Finger of Death
programme.desc: The story centers on a secret society that plots to overthrow the Qing Dynasty and resume the Ming monarchy. The organization gains the support of numerous righteous martial clans, but the Qing government has its own plans of squashing the rebellion. The scheming prince of Qing poisons the rebels' central figure, Chi Zi Qiang (Jimmy Wang), and uses the antidote to force him to surrender.

programme.title: Shogun's Samurai
programme.desc: Iemitsu attempts to solidify the bond between the shogunate and the imperial court by offering his sister to be the consort of the emperor. A series of conspiracies led to the formation of the notorious Ura-yagyu group, led by Jubei.

programme.title: Lethal Three - Sanbiki ga Kiru
programme.desc: Tako meets a beautiful girl in jail. When they get out, she is attacked by a group of men. Tako and Lord come to her aid, but now must discover why those men were after her.
programme.sub-title: Lethal Three - Sanbiki ga Kiru: Episode 7

programme.title: Island Art of SILAT
programme.desc: A Journey across Indonesia to explore the relatively undiscovered martial art of Pencak Silat and to reveal the secrets of Silat to a waiting audience worldwide. Historically, technique was passed down from generation to generation within the same bloodline and written records and public demonstrations were rare. "Our Silat was only for our family" says Mas Amien of Chakra Lima. "Before 2007 we never shared our technique.

programme.title: 72 Desperate Rebels
programme.desc: A true classic! An all star cast with untold weapons! The Emperor's spy (Wei Tze-Yung), the daughter of the killed governor Shih Han (Wei Hai-Min), a mysterious mercenary (Wan Shan) and a blind swordsman (Lung Fei) team up to defeat chief pirate (Bai Ying), leader of the 72 Desperate Rebels, but eventually it will be his daughter (Yang Hsiu-Chian) who will decide at the end of the movie. This superb martial arts movie has nice imaginative touches and a very good planning direction.

programme.title: Secret Rivals
programme.desc: A classic kung fu movie! Wong Tao plays Shen Yi Wei, the son of a General, who travels to Gold Valley in Korea, to investigate a gold heist that took place 3 years ago. Shen Yi Wei finds out that the only way that he can get closer to the gang that robbed the gold, is by entering a competition sponsored by the gang leader, who is looking for a top kung fu fighter to become his bodyguard.

programme.title: A Love Letter to the Beatles

programme.title: Deceptive Touch
programme.desc: Cam believes she's finally found The One in her charismatic boyfriend Ant. Everything seems perfect until a shocking discovery about Ant's past threatens to unravel their idyllic life. As Cam digs for answers, passion turns into paranoia, and a twisted game of lies and manipulation threatens to destroy everything she thought she knew.

programme.title: The Housekeeper
programme.desc: After the death of her son, Sharease Smalls loses everything, and is forced to move back in with her sister Elise. Struggling to find steady work, Sharease agrees to become a live-in housekeeper for a local crime boss, Zues. The pairs professional relationship soon turns intimate, but it's only a veil of secrets and lies. Will Sharease survive the truth?

programme.title: Bruised 2
programme.desc: Two years after the death of her husband, Kayla Brown has rebuilt her life following the launch of her successful memoir. She is then visited by a stalker, who is hell-bent on making her pay for what she has done in order to escape her husband.

programme.title: Cougar
programme.desc: Donna and her young college son Brandon live in a nice suburban area of Atlanta, until a new and mysterious older woman moves in next door. Donna invites her over to dinner where she and Brandon connect, and build a connection that is deadly and manipulative. A mother must save her son before it's too late.

programme.title: Bloodlines
programme.desc: Sydney Carter is a restless college student that has always felt out of place. When she discovers she's adopted, her world beings to unravel, and she embarks on a journey to discover her origins, but they come at a cost, and could destroy everything she's ever known.

programme.title: Unwitting Deceit
programme.desc: Tone and Omar, business associates in the world of black market diamond sales, quickly become enemies after an unknowingly but deceitful act. They are forced to set aside their differences in order to accomplish one common goal, get out of a critical situation and to not serve time. In the process, something is uncovered way deeper than what meets the eye.

programme.title: When it Rains
programme.desc: While Todd is away at Graduate school to better his family, his wife Janice is back home taking care of her sick mother. The long distance marriage takes a toll on the two. When Todd ends up encountering a woman named Sharon at a bar, sparks fly.

programme.title: The Underwoods of Napa Valley

programme.title: Neurotic Beauty
programme.desc: Imari Jacobs is bored in his marriage but finds the excitement he's looking for in a breathtaking model. However, Imari discovers that this new love may not be worth chasing.

programme.title: The Last Assignment

When the agency finds out that he may not execute the mission as planned, it becomes a game of cat and mouse as he decides the fate of his new friend and the woman he truly loves.....who also has a dark secret.

programme.title: No Hamburg No Beatles
programme.desc: Journey to the wild, vice-filled streets of 1960s Hamburg, West Germany, where five young lads from Liverpool - John, Paul, George, Stuart and Pete - evolved into the Fab Four: John, Paul, George and Ringo. Witness their gritty apprenticeship-from all-night sets in seedy clubs fueled by drink and drugs to brushes with the law, personal tragedies, and the relentless honing of their sound. This is the untold story of their defining years. No Hamburg? No Beatles!

programme.title: Murder on the Blade

programme.title: Shuttered Secrets

Their reunion quickly spirals into psychological warfare and violence. As the night goes on, the line between predator and victim blurs when other mysterious figures arrive and everything must be questioned.

programme.title: Angel and Demon

Their toxic romance spirals into a world of gang violence and threatens Angel's once promising future.

programme.title: Reality TV Murders

When one of the castmates is found dead, the women become suspects and we discover that some of the women would literally kill to be famous.

programme.title: A Wonderful Lie
programme.desc: Fading romance author Rebecca Sinclair concocts a desperate plan to reignite her dwindling career and fractured marriage. She creates a web of lies and her twisted plot leaves her trapped in a nightmare of her own making. programme.sub-title: Rookie Robot - SPRING, SUMMER, FALL & WINTER - ROOKIE AND THE 4 SEASONS

programme.title: Modern Warfare: Terrorism
programme.desc: The very nature of terrorism has changed. Suicide Bombings, Hijacking, violent attacks, and the taking of hostages has become the standard.

programme.title: Hitler's Propaganda Machine

programme.title: Embedded 45' Shooting War in Germany
programme.desc: This first episode covers the last week of February to late March. When American troops started their final invasion of Nazi Germany in February 1945, U.S. Army cameramen were at their side. Over a thousand reels have been preserved; many of them untouched for decades. The cameramen covered many stories of victory and defeat, death and liberation. Faces of despair and joy, scenes of war and peace.

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: As Hitler focussed on Russia, the situation in the Pacific developed to epic proportions when the Japanese air force attacked the American Naval Fleet at Pearl Harbour on the 7th of December. This immediately brought the USA into the Theatre of War.

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: With Britain no longer facing Hitler alone, the first GIs arrived in the UK. As Singapore fell, the Allies looked on in horror as Japan also had control of Java, Burma and New Guinea, as they edged ever closer towards Australia.

programme.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days
programme.desc: 'Independence Day in Europe - In France, Eisenhower observes General Bradley fire a giant howitzer signaling our artillery into a massed crescendo of fire. Following the landing battles in Normandy, the Canadians return to the thick of the fighting at Cariquet. So severe that some Canadian camera crew were killed. In their sector, the Yanks are blazing through the hedge rows with grenade guns.

programme.title: WWII In Color: D-Day to Nazi Downfall
programme.desc: American forces, already frayed and fatigued from the long bloody battles leading to the Siegfried Line, and hampered by weather and overstretched supply lines, reel from the impact of massive surprise attack along an 80-mile front in The Ardennes Forest.

programme.title: Naval Warfare in World War II
programme.desc: The Allied invasion of Normandy is detailed-from preparation to execution-courtesy of vintage footage from both sides. A great victory for the Allies.

programme.title: The Armstrong 100 Ton Gun
programme.desc: The Armstrong 100 Ton Gun was first created in the late 1870's, and was easily the largest weapon of the time. Weighing in at 103,888 kg, the 100 Ton Gun had an length of 9.953 meters, and took a crew of 35 men, including 18 men just to handle the ammunition. The gun was originally offered to the Royal Navy, who deemed it too heavy for use. The Italian Regia Marina then took the gun into service.

programme.title: The Crusade in Europe
programme.desc: The surrender at Reims ended the major phase of the European Theater of WWII. The film dissolves from the surrender to Hitler in his early years of power, follows the rise of Nazism through the Munich Pact, the attack on Poland, the fall of France, and the Battle of Britain.

programme.title: Baby Cages: The Denazification Of Hitler Youth
programme.desc: In a final insane attempt to turn the tide of the war, Hitler recruited from the Hitler Youth, enlisting children as young as 12 years old. Around 10,000 of these young fighters, who were both persecutors and victims, would be taken prisoner by the Americans. A re-education program started at Attichy Camp to steer them towards an attitude of tolerance and democracy. It was called 'Baby Cages'.

programme.title: The Amazing World of War Machines
programme.desc: Beneath the waves lurks a stealthy war machine. Capable of carrying nuclear weapons, submarines play a key role in the defense of many countries around the world today. The earliest beginnings of submarines can be traced back to the time of Alexander the Great in 323 B.C. In 1776 American inventor David Bushnell designed and constructed the first military submarine.

programme.title: Great Tank Battles
programme.desc: The fourth episode sees the Germans well and truly on the retreat and the Allies are able to successfully implement operation Husky - the landing on Sicily - where General Montgomery and the American General George Smith Patton ousted the Germans in little over five weeks. On the Eastern Front General Zhukov inflicted heavy defeat on the Germans now having the new T - 54 tank available.

programme.title: Baby Cages: The Denazification Of Hitler Youth
programme.desc: In a final insane attempt to turn the tide of the war, Hitler recruited from the Hitler Youth, enlisting children as young as 12 years old. Around 10,000 of these young fighters, who were both persecutors and victims, would be taken prisoner by the Americans. A re-education program started at Attichy Camp to steer them towards an attitude of tolerance and democracy. It was called 'Baby Cages'.

programme.title: War Machines
programme.desc: The 20th century saw a deadly leap in technology. This episode explores mankind's most fearsome creations-chemical, atomic, robotic, and nuclear weapons. From banned gases to bombs that level cities, it's the story of ultimate destruction. Some were used, others were not-but all redefined the scale of warfare and the terrifying potential of future conflicts.

programme.title: WWII In Color: US Army Air Forces
programme.desc: Hitler's fortress Europe begins to crumble with Nazi occupying forces fall back on every front. The US Army Air Force grows to become the biggest armada the world has ever seen, gaining the air superiority needed to ensure complete victory.

programme.title: The Crusade in Europe
programme.desc: The surrender at Reims ended the major phase of the European Theater of WWII. The film dissolves from the surrender to Hitler in his early years of power, follows the rise of Nazism through the Munich Pact, the attack on Poland, the fall of France, and the Battle of Britain.

programme.title: Secrets of the Nazis
programme.desc: With recolorized archives, this episode explores the final year of Hitler's infamous division. From recruitment and indoctrination to their last missions, we uncover who these men were-and how they became perpetrators of mass murder. Following their brutal combat and crimes against humanity, we confront the chaos, ideology, and horror that defined the Das Reich's final descent.
programme.sub-title: Hitler's Death Army - Part II: Death and Decline

programme.title: War Machines
programme.desc: When humans took to the skies, they brought war with them. This episode traces aerial combat from WWI dogfights to bombers, jets, and drones. Exploring how air power evolved into one of the deadliest forces in warfare, it highlights the relentless drive to fly faster, strike harder, and control the skies-forever changing the face of battle from above.

programme.title: The Night of the Long Knives: Hitler's Rise to Power
programme.desc: The Night of the Long Knives is considered the first act of horror committed by the Nazis. What happened in Germany, and in Hitler's rise to power, that led to this purge in 1934? Caught between the conservative tendency and the revolutionary aspirations that were dividing the country, the Chancellor had a choice. To calm the rumors of a military coup against him, Hitler sent a clear message.

programme.title: The Bomber: Terror of World War II
programme.desc: Tokyo's firebombing proved deadly-wood and paper homes made cities burn fast. The B-29 bomber and napalm upped the carnage. In Europe, USAAF and RAF bombed day and night. New tech like bunker busters and bouncing bombs made targets harder to hide. The bomber was now war's most fearsome force.

programme.title: Secrets of the Nazis
programme.desc: Amateur filmmakers in Normandy secretly documented daily life between 1939-1945, risking arrest under Nazi rule. Preserved for decades, their footage reveals war's darkest hours-shortages, fear, and ruins-yet also family bonds, joy, and hope. This documentary offers an extraordinary civilian perspective, intertwining anonymous lives with the unfolding tragedy and liberation of WWII.

programme.title: Battlefields
programme.desc: June 5th, 1944, 9:30 PM. 13,348 men from two American parachute divisions, the 82nd and the 101st Airborne in nearly 1,000 aircraft will take off to Normandy. Until then, no one had launched an airborne operation of this scale. The Allied staff is expecting huge losses! Some forecasts predict 75% of the paratroopers will fall in combat. They must open the way to the troops landing on Utah Beach.

programme.title: The Big Attack: Combat Heroes of WWII
programme.desc: In mid-August 1944, the Allies launched 'Operation Anvil' to increase pressure on German troops after the Normandy landings. The 517th Airborne was tasked with preventing enemy tanks from reaching the beachhead. This episode recounts the story of three American sergeants and a British major who jumped into enemy territory, successfully completed their mission, and survived to tell the tale.

programme.title: Soviet Storm
programme.desc: After the failure to take both Moscow and Leningrad, Hitler sets his sights on the oil fields in the Caucasus. If captured, the Red Army will lose 70-90% of all its oil resources. Therefore, the famous city on the Volga, Stalingrad, must be 'held at all costs.' The German General Staff thinks taking the city will be a matter of a few weeks, but events steadily turn against the Germans.

programme.title: WWII War Diaries
programme.desc: In this third film of the series, '1941', see how Adolf Hitler increased the Nazi stranglehold on Europe, while Winston Churchill inspired the people of Britain to stand together as the nightly Luftwaffe bombing raids were extended to include the nation's vital ports, as well as the capital, London.

programme.title: The Big Attack: Combat Heroes of WWII
programme.desc: Meet Jose Lopez, a man who can forage chicken from deserted farms and cook it, a la Mexican, but also a fighting man. Watch him prove himself, carrying weapons and ammunition through enemy fire, firing his machine gun with deadly accuracy, holding off almost singlehandedly a deadly attack. Watch this Laredo, Texas, born-and-bred soldier earn the nation's highest award and the nickname, 'Tex'.

programme.title: Soviet Storm
programme.desc: Germany is retreating on all fronts and suffering defeat after defeat. The breach of Germany's pre-War borders now seems inevitable. Desperate, Hitler orders all males between the ages of 16 and 70 to enlist and fight for the fatherland. Nazi ideologues put faith in victory and the Nazis seem to vanquish and suppress all forms of doubt and resistance in the last months of the Reich.

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: The American Navy got back on course after Pearl Harbour, and in the four-day Battle for the Coral Sea, they claimed victory, before defeating Japan again in the decisive Battle of Midway. Elsewhere the Luftwaffe targeted more British cities.
programme.sub-title: The Battle of Midway and Beyond: April-June 1942

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: Hitler's 'Desert Fox', Rommel advanced at El Alamein, but with the arrival of British General, Bernard Montgomery, to lead the Eighth Army in North Africa, the wind of change was about to blow.

programme.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days
programme.desc: Prefabricated concrete barges are manufactured in preparation for D Day. U.S. troops storm a beach in a practice landing assault. How harbor facilities made in England were used in the Normandy invasion. A storm damages the harbor but unloading continues.
programme.sub-title: Newsreel Reports on Preparation for D-Day

programme.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days
programme.desc: The processing of plasma and penicillin. Troops in Normandy receive medical care. Naval guns bombard Cherbourg. The 8th and 9th Air Forces bomb communication lines. British troops take Caen. Shows Gen. Montgomery.
programme.sub-title: First Aid and the Taking of Cherbourg

programme.title: WWII: On the Edge of the Abyss
programme.desc: With the fall of Nazi Germany, the focus shifts to the Pacific, where Japan continues to resist fiercely. This episode covers the brutal island campaigns, kamikaze attacks, and the increasingly destructive U.S. bombing campaigns. Japan's refusal to surrender prompts the U.S. to deploy a new and terrifying weapon: the atomic bomb.

programme.title: Visions of War: Infantry Weapons and Tactics
programme.desc: A historical record of the 281 days of the 3rd army offensive through France, Belgium and Germany, with air support from the 19th tactical air command.

programme.title: Nazi Concentration Camps
programme.desc: This film is the official documentary report compiled from over 80,000 feet of film shot by Allied military photographers in the German concentration camps immediately after liberation. The footage is a camp-by-camp record taken in order to provide lasting objective proof of the horrors the liberators witnessed. Some emphasis is also placed on the humanitarian work done in camps by the liberators.

programme.title: Blood Money - Inside the Soviet Economy
programme.desc: By 1942, Soviet industry-rebuilt in the east-fueled the Red Army with mass-produced tanks, planes, and weapons, reversing the tide at Stalingrad. But while the war economy thrived, civilians starved under famine and rationing. With Allied aid and relentless sacrifice, the USSR rose as an industrial giant-at a staggering human cost.

programme.title: The Crimean War
programme.desc: The first program looks at the reasons behind the war, and why Britain allied itself against Imperial Russia.

programme.title: Blitzed: Nazis on Drugs
programme.desc: In 1938 a drug called Pervitin was created in Nazi Germany. This drug was distributed to German soldiers during the course of WW2 and Hitler was no exception to these drug highs receiving drug cocktails from his personal physical Theodor Morell. This film explores the use of drugs in WW2 and looks at the potential effects that drugs could have had on Hitler, soldiers and the war itself.

programme.title: D-Day: 100 Days for Freedom
programme.desc: From the hedgerows of Normandy to the liberation of Paris, this episode retraces the 100 critical days after D-Day. Witness the fierce battles, the resilience of soldiers, and the toll on civilians as the Allies push through German defenses, paving the way for Europe's liberation and altering the course of World War II.

programme.title: WWII War Diaries
programme.desc: In '1940,' we follow Hitler's trail of occupation into Denmark and Norway, the invasion of Belgium and France & the Miracle Of Dunkirk where Churchill initiated Operation Dynamo to rescue the thousands of BEF that were stranded & helpless on the beaches under relentless Nazi attack. See how Hitler's Blitzkrieg ripped through France and how the British survive The Blitz & win the Battle Of Britain.

programme.title: Soviet Storm
programme.desc: Leningrad, a vital and large Baltic sea port, is facing the entire weight of Army Group North. The Soviets have no reserves to spare as the Battle of Moscow is about to begin. Wilhelm von Leeb's Army Group North fails to take Leningrad, but begins a horrible siege that will last 872 days, in which over a million civilians will die of starvation and disease.

programme.title: The Big Attack: Combat Heroes of WWII
programme.desc: This is the story of a young apple-cheeked Sergeant nick-named 'Ma' by his men because of his protective nature toward their scouting unit. It is also the tale of Pat Cassidy, a looter of watches and wine and a member of Horner's unit. How these two opposites combine their talents to single-handedly capture a German-held land mine control center, makes a spellbinding, action-packed episode.

programme.title: Nuclear Test Films
programme.desc: First experimental blast set off in New Mexico; bombing and devastation of Hiroshima and Nagasaki. and devastation of Hiroshima and Nagasaki.

programme.title: Hitler: A Strategy of Failure
programme.desc: Adolf Hitler, considered himself to be the world's greatest military strategist - superior even to Napoleon Bonaparte - and early Blitzkrieg successes could be said to easily confirm this assertion. So why did the Nazis lose the war? Hitler also made colossal strategic military blunders: Dunkirk, Operation Barbarossa and many others that were ultimately a strategy of failure.

programme.title: The Crimean War

programme.title: Death in the Bunker
programme.desc: Death In The Bunker: The True Story of Hitler's Downfall examines the final 10 days in the Berlin Führerbunker deep below the Chancellery of the Reich. Includes interviews with Hitler's confidants and eyewitnesses including Hitler's Secretary Traudl Junge who after typing out Hitler's will, remained in the bunker until his death. Learn firsthand what happened in the bunker right to the very end.

We see the care a man receives from medics all along the line; from the time the wounded soldier calls 'Medic' until he is released for duty. The Medical Corps is saving more lives than in any other time of combat. Lieutenant Colonel S. J. Newsom of San Diego, California tells the story in an interview with Captain Zimmerman.
programme.sub-title: Big Picture: The Army Medical Corps

programme.desc: In the pacific, in Europe, and on the continents of Africa and Asia, every branch of the air services now forms close partnerships with the other branches of the armed forces. The roles of transport and supply must now be balanced with combat, and the Army Air Force focuses on protecting allied interests on land and across the oceans.

programme.title: The Yorkshire Vet
programme.desc: Collette and her son Cailean are fanatical ferret fanciers and have 39 at their home! But their prize-winning, champion ferret favourite, Teddy, has a problem. They've spotted a lump and Collette fears the worst. Can Peter save Teddy?

programme.title: Baby Animals and Friends

programme.desc: Our day is taking us on to the vast African Savanna. With its endless grass plains, leafy acacias and tropical climate its one of the richest environments on Earth, supporting millions of animals. Among them we see featured baby elephants, lion cubs, and wildebeest calves.

programme.title: The Yorkshire Vet
programme.desc: In the middle of a storm an an alpaca gave birth to a cria. Peter gets the call to see if he has more than just a chill. programme.title: The Dog Rescuers

programme.title: The Dog House Australia
programme.desc: Emily hopes that bringing a dog into their home will offer a calming influence to her Neurodiverse son Jacob. And will Digger the Jack Russell prove worthy of being emotional support for young Harper?

programme.title: The Yorkshire Vet
programme.desc: Julian returns to Jacki Barlow's alpaca farm to investigate a worrying lump in the mouth of one of the animals. Peter carries out dental surgery on a Yorkshire terrier and Julian examines a pygmy-goat.

programme.title: The Yorkshire Vet

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The chefs must cook their fish courses but with some exceptionally high scoring dishes in the regional heats, each chef will need to deliver perfection in order to see off the competition. The judges are joined by guest judge Tim Henman.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is main course day and with only two spots remaining on the banquet menu, the competition is fierce. As the barbecues are fired up, all eight chefs are feeling the heat. The judges are joined by guest judge Gordon Reid.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is dessert day and with just one place remaining at the Wimbledon banquet, each chef is giving everything they have got. The judges are joined by guest judge Annabel Croft, former British number one and Junior Wimbledon champion.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's the grand finale and the winning chefs must now cook their dishes at the banquet. Once in the kitchen, the chefs face the huge challenge of scaling up their dishes.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Competing for top spot are Danny Parker, head chef at Michelin starred 'House of Tides' in Newcastle, who is back to try his luck in the competition again after being knocked out in the regional heat last year following a tense tie-break. He's taking on two newcomers: Dan Fletcher, protégé of Phil Howard, and now head chef at 'Fenchurch' in the City of London, and David Coulson, who runs 'Peace and Loaf' in Newcastle, which boasts 2 AA rosettes.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: After a tense starter course the chefs are all aiming for 10s with their unique fish dishes. David is celebrating a personal connection to the brief with his `My Cod I Bet Me Ma'am Has Seen Some Trotters', a tribute to his mum who has worked as a chiropodist. Dan's `For All Those Sleepless Nights' pays tribute to night shift workers from the NHS with some bold but classic flavours while Danny's `Not All Superheroes Wear Capes' aims to give a taste of luxury to the hardworking staff.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Dan pays tribute to an icon of modern nursing, Florence Nightingale, while Danny is inspired by the founder of the NHS, Aneurin Bevan. David's dish is dedicated to the air ambulance staff who saved the life of his fiancé, and he even takes a trip to meet one of them.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's the chefs' last chance to impress and tensions are high. Dan takes a risk with an unusual combination of ewe's milk and bergamot while Danny is determined to pull out all the stops with his complex dessert `Aunty Gwen's Chocolate'. David hopes to transform a childhood comfort classic into a show stopping dessert. Dan also takes a trip to meet Dr Ben Clarke who was working in the Royal London Hospital A&E during the London Bridge terror attack.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The two remaining North East chefs must cook their four-course menus again, but will they take on board their veteran's advice as they serve their 'Feast To Say Thank You'?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Banquet champion Selin Kiazim, a rising star of the London scene renowned for her Turkish Cypriot fusion flavours, is back hoping to join the elite group of chefs who have made it to the banquet twice. She is up against James Cochran who's worked at some of London's toughest kitchens including 2 Michelin starred 'The Ledbury' and Scott Goss from 'The Twenty Six' in Tunbridge Wells, renowned for his use of local Kent ingredients.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The chefs do battle for the fish course and the atmosphere in the kitchen is tense. Lobster is catch of the day for James whose dish is Caribbean-inspired. Scott is attempting to elevate a classic fish pie, dedicated to his mum who worked as a pharmacist in the NHS for 23 years. And Selin is taking a risk with a complex three-part fish dish featuring sardines, scallops and langoustines, as a nod to the purported health benefits of a Mediterranean diet.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Scott is showcasing rare-breed Tamworth pork to say thank you to the rare breed of people who work for the NHS. Selin is serving a complex duck dish using ingredients from all around the world to honour `Our Global NHS'. And James is presenting five cuts of goat cooked in five different ways, for his bold dish `Under The Knife'.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Selin puts her own unique twist on tea and toast. James creates a decadent coconut parfait accompanied by mango purée filled doughnuts for his dessert 'Tree of Life' inspired by the coconut palm tree, the NHS and both of their contributions to our health. Scott hopes his elevated gypsy tart 'Honey Bee Good' will secure him a place in the final.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The two remaining London and the south-east chefs must cook their four-course menus again, but will they take on board their veteran's advice as they remake their 'Feast To Say Thank You'?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Vying to be crowned champion of Scotland are three newcomers to the GBM kitchen. Lorna McNee is a former Scottish Chef of the Year and is renowned for her technical precision, gained from working at two-Michelin-starred restaurant 'Andrew Fairlie'.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the fish course and the chefs are all out to impress. The heat is increased as all three serve their unique takes on lobster. Ross seeks victory with his dish 'Lobster Aid'. Lorna's 'Live Well, Live Very Well' features only three elements.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Ross is hoping to impress with 'Oh Deer It's Time For Your Penicillin', his tribute to Scottish scientist Alexander Fleming featuring an unusual yeast element as well as venison. Across the kitchen, Lorna, a former Game Chef of the Year, is also cooking venison in a bid to impress.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Ross is attempting to elevate a classic into a dish worthy of the banquet, Lorna is cooking a personal tribute to NHS staff using unusual yuzu and tonka bean flavours, and Ben is serving an experimental dish which includes a beeswax ice cream.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is judging day and the two remaining chefs must impress the panel of Oliver Peyton, Andi Oliver and Matthew Fort. Both chefs are gunning for success and are doing everything they can to deliver their menus to perfection.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Three chefs compete in the heat for the central region. Returner Ryan Simson-Trotman, who failed to reach the national finals last year, is originally from Nuneaton and opened his own restaurant Orwells in the Oxfordshire countryside with his partner Liam, who is also a contestant in the North West region.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the fish course and the chefs are pulling out all the stops. Marianne pays tribute to the `angels' in her local hospital who looked after her during a recent illness, and Ryan's dish is a reference to the purported health benefits of fish high in omega 3 oils, while Sabrina is inspired by her aunt, a retired nurse who used to take in food to share with her fellow workers during her shifts.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The chefs cook their mains and, following the previous day's results, tension is high. Both Marianne and Ryan are cooking muntjac in the hope of impressing the veteran judge, while Sabrina is making an ambitious technical take on a family feast.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: With one dish left to impress the veteran judge, the chefs cook their desserts. Marianne is looking to raise a smile with her 'carry on' themed dessert, complete with surprise presentation. Sabrina hopes to make it through with an elevated take on jelly and ice cream while Ryan goes all out with his very sweet treat 'A Spoonful of Sugar'.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The two remaining central region chefs do battle for a place in the national finals. They must impress the formidable panel of Andi Oliver, Matthew Fort and Oliver Peyton with their four-course menus.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Andrew is attempting to pay tribute to NHS staff with his take on a traditional healing recipe, 'Mum's Flu-Fighting Chicken Soup'. Jason's 'A Tea From The Heart' is a play on a post-war remedy which harks back to the era when the NHS was formed.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: After the starter results, the chefs return to the kitchen hoping for high scores with their fish dishes. Chris once again is using ingredients he has foraged from around his restaurant, while Jason hopes to impress with a spicy scallop dish and Andrew prepares a cod dish with 11 different elements.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The chefs are pulling out all the stops in a bid for big scores with their mains. All three dishes pay tribute to the founder of the NHS Aneurin Bevan, Chris's 'Everything But The Squeal' is an ambitious pork sharing platter, while Jason's 'For The Rich And The Poor' showcases lamb, and Andrew is hoping to impress with 'Aneurin Bevan For Better Steak'.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the dessert course and the last opportunity for the chefs to impress. Chris is hoping to triumph with another dish which showcases the foraged ingredients available around his restaurant, while Jason attempts a technical feat in his dessert inspired by a childhood hospital stay and Andrew is inspired by a dish by his great-grandmother used to cook. Which two will make it through to the judging chamber?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the Wales regional final as the two remaining chefs do everything they can to impress the judging panel of Andi Oliver, Matthew Fort and Oliver Peyton. After tensions ran high in the week, the chefs are under pressure to deliver perfection. The judges are joined by Aneira Thomas, the first baby born on the NHS, who is named in tribute to the service's founder Aneurin Bevan and who went on to dedicate her life to the service. Who will win a place in the national finals?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's the turn of three chefs representing the south-west, including two who have competed before but meet in the kitchen this week for the very first time. The chefs meet their surprise veteran judge and cook their celebratory starters.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's the fish course and with Tom renowned as a fish specialist all eyes are on him. He's cooking his take on a classic British fish supper in tribute to a charity which looks after the health of local fishermen. Jude is attempting a complex fusion dish featuring four different fish and an unusual X-Ray themed presentation, while Olivia is paying tribute to the staff who looked after her during the birth of her first son with her take on curried monkfish.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's the main course and two of the chefs are hoping duck will win the day. Tom is preparing a technically challenging duck dish steeped in NHS history while Jude is making a multi-element Chinese duck dish inspired by his mum. Olivia is hoping her dish, using two unusual cuts of beef, will score top points. Olivia also visits her local children's hospital, home of the second-busiest paediatric A&E in the country.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: With just one more chance to impress their veteran judge, the chefs are all hoping to use their pastry skills to deliver technically complex desserts. Tom's cooking an 'Invalid Fruit Tart' inspired by a 1950s recipe, while Jude is making six different apple elements for his 'An Apple A Day'. Olivia is using stout in reference to an outdated old wives' tale which suggested the drink was a healthy source of iron during pregnancy.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's time for the two remaining chefs representing the South West to go head-to-head as they cook their menus again for the exacting panel of Andi Oliver, Matthew Fort and Oliver Peyton. With a spot in the National Finals at stake, both are aiming for perfection as they bid for glory. The judges are joined by Barbara Childs, a Matron in the Cardiac Intensive Care Unit at Great Ormond Street Hospital, who isn't afraid to speak her mind in the chamber.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Three chefs take to the kitchen in a bid to represent the north-west in the national final. They include Ellis Barrie, from the award-winning Marram Grass in Anglesey, Liam Simpson-Trotman, an accomplished pastry chef and co-owner of the 4 AA rosette Orwell's in Oxfordshire, and Craig Sherrington, who sharpened his skills working under top names including Eric Chavot and is now Chef Patron of Virginia House in Cumbria.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's the fish course and the chefs are all gunning for tens. Craig pays tribute to a friend who has revolutionised hospital food in Morecambe Bay, while Liam is inspired by health advice his grandma gave him and Ellis is dedicating his dish to the staff who delivered his son Albert. With cod, mackerel, shrimp and cockles on the menu, which of the chefs will score highly?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Time for the chefs to cook their mains and the pressure is on. Craig is hoping to impress using two cuts of Dexter beef, while Liam prepares his take on a Bajan lamb stew and Ellis prepares four cuts of suckling pig. Liam meets his personal hero, Nola Ishmael OBE, who became the UK's first ever black Director of Nursing.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's the dessert course and the last chance for the North West chefs to impress in a bid to make it through to the regional final. Liam is cooking 'Not So Hot Toddy' in honour of a friend who works night shifts in the NHS, while Ellis' 'Worth Their Weight in Gold' is dedicated to the staff who saved his brother's life and Craig's dish 'The Missed Celebration' pays tribute to his wife with an unusual Christmas concept.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The two highest scoring chefs from the week return to cook their menus again. Judging them are Matthew Fort, Oliver Peyton and Andi Oliver who are joined by Dr Jake Dunning MBE, an infectious disease specialist who has been recognised for his work during the West Africa Ebola epidemic.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Three chefs are doing battle to represent Northern Ireland. Tommy Heaney, Head Chef at the Great House Hotel in South Wales, is taken on by Shauna Froydenlund, Chef Patron at Marcus Wareing's two Michelin starred restaurant, and James Devine, the 2017 National Chef of the Year.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: After a tense starter course, the chefs return to the kitchen to cook their fish dishes. James is making his elevated take on a fried chicken takeaway as a tribute to the NHS staff who care for his sister. Shauna is also taking inspiration from a personal connection with a tribute to staff from a facility in her hometown of Londonderry. Tommy is hoping to impress with a dish dedicated to the discovery of DNA.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: With two courses down it's time for the chefs to cook their main courses. It's the battle of beef with each using the same meat in their innovative creations. Tommy also meets the first baby ever born on the NHS.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's the dessert course and the final chance for the chefs to impress. After such a tightly fought battle all week, each is hoping to deliver a technically perfect dessert. Tommy and James are both using passion fruit in their complex dishes while Shauna is hoping to use her pastry chef training to score full marks.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The two chefs representing Northern Ireland go head-to-head. Judging as ever are Oliver Peyton, Matthew Fort and Andi Oliver who are joined by Shehan Hettiaratchy, lead trauma surgeon at St Mary's Hospital who helped treat victims of the Grenfell Tower fire.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The winning chefs from all eight regions must battle it out for the honour of a spot on 2018's 'Feast To Say Thank You' banquet menu, celebrating 70 years of the NHS, one of Britain's most prized institutions.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The chefs must prepare fish courses, and after some exceptionally high-scoring dishes in the starter round, everyone is desperate to deliver perfection. Once again, the chefs present their innovative, witty and heart-warming creations.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's main course day and with only two spots remaining on the banquet menu, the competition is fierce. Both chefs and judges alike are amazed at the high standard of cooking and an incredible number of 10s are dished out as the chefs serve up venison, rabbit, duck, beef, lamb and pork for scrutiny.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's dessert day and with just one place remaining at the banquet feast, each chef is giving everything they've got for a chance to say thank you to the heroic NHS staff. All the chefs have significantly re-worked or re-invented their desserts since the regional heats, proving that they'll do everything they can in a bid for that final winning spot.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's the grand finale as the winning chefs cook their dishes at a banquet for the heroes of the NHS. Having arrived at St Bartholomew's Hospital, the chefs are shown the incredible location for event, the almost three-hundred-year-old Great Hall.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Competing for the top spot are 3 new chefs to the competition representing some of the most exciting culinary talent from London, Paul Walsh, Luke Selby and Ben Marks.
programme.sub-title: London and South East - Starter and Fish Courses

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The three chefs are halfway through their heat and the pressure is mounting. Only two will proceed to Friday's judging and have a chance to represent the London and the South East region at the regional finals.
programme.sub-title: London and South East Mains and Desserts

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The two remaining London chefs must cook their four-course menus again. The chefs need to impress the formidable judges: food writer Matthew Fort, restaurateur Oliver Peyton and broadcaster and cook Andi Oliver as well as a guest judge.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Three chefs new to the competition compete in the North East heats. Three of the region's chefs battle it out for the top spot: Mike Carr, Samira Effa, and Tom Anglesea. The three chefs must present the menu of their careers, inspired by 50 years of British pop music.
programme.sub-title: North East: Starter and Fish Courses

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The chefs are halfway through their heat and will serve up their main courses and desserts. The stakes are high, and again they are each serving a unique take on the pop music brief. Mike is confident about his northern dish, 'Rack n Roll', which puts both classic Yorkshire hogget and traditional Lancashire hotpot in the spotlight.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The two remaining North East chefs must cook their four-course menus again for the judges: food writer Matthew Fort, restaurateur Oliver Peyton and broadcaster and cook Andi Oliver as well as a guest judge, one of the British pop industry's finest.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Newcomer Kray brings an urban edge to proceedings, with a starter inspired by grime music called 'Fire in the Booth'. It combines hot sauce, veal sweetbreads and tuna belly. Returner Sabrina is compiling a dish of her favourite ingredients, including pasta and ox cheek, for her Italian inspired starter called 'My Mixtape'.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: For his main course, Ryan Simpson-Trotman is confident his dish, `The UK's Number 1', will hit the top spot with his combination of a beef pie and rump cap. Sabrina Gidda is taking inspiration from her grandad's collection of old 45s for her `Sunday Jukebox' main: pork Wellington and Black Country faggots.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The two remaining Central chefs must cook their four-course menus again for judges food writer Matthew Fort, restaurateur Oliver Peyton and broadcaster and cook Andi Oliver as well as a guest judge.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Competing for a place on the banquet menu are two chefs returning to the competition for a second time, plus a supremely talented newcomer. Liam Simpson, who co-owns a high-end gastropub near Henley-on-Thames, is hoping to make it all the way after being knocked out in the heats during the 2018 competition.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The chefs are halfway through the regional heats and, as the lowest scoring chef will be eliminated from the competition at the end of the show, the pressure is on. They start by cooking their all-important main courses, the centrepiece of the banquet menu. Michelin-starred newcomer Hrishikesh Desai is pushing himself to the limit with a complex multipart venison dish, inspired by the bands which play at the Kendal Calling music festival.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The two remaining chefs from the north-west cook their dishes head to head for a panel of expert judges, in a bid to secure themselves a place in the national finals. Will they have acted on the advice given by the veteran judge earlier in the week, and learn from their mistakes?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Three of Scotland's finest chefs do battle for a chance to cook at the banquet celebrating 50 Years of Popular Music. Gordon Jones, the only newcomer, faces returners Lorna McNee and Ben Reade, who are going head-to-head for the second time.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The chefs cook their mains and desserts, each battling to produce smash hit dishes that wow their veteran. For her main, Lorna is confident her lamb dish `With A Little Help From My Friends', dedicated to supportive friends, is a celebratory dish fit for the banquet.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The two remaining Scottish chefs must cook their four courses again, but this time they'll need to appeal to four new palates. Food writer Matthew Fort, restaurateur Oliver Peyton, broadcaster and cook Andi Oliver plus a celebrity guest judge.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Emily Scott is the chef proprietor of Cornwall's renowned 'St Tudy Inn'. Her two rivals are from across the sea on Jersey. Joe Baker is largely self-taught, but at just 28 already running his own restaurant, 'No 10', in St Helier. A neighbouring restaurant is Michelin starred 'Samphire' where Lee Smith is head chef.

programme.title: Great British Menu

programme.title: Fear Factor USA

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
